name: Mini-Trello
description: BoardHub is a ready-to-deploy project management application inspired by Kanban boards, designed to help teams organize tasks and collaborate effectively. Built with a serverless architecture and MongoDB.

paragraphs: BoardHub is a ready-to-deploy project management application inspired by Kanban boards, designed to help teams organize tasks and collaborate effectively. Built with a serverless architecture and MongoDB, it offers a free, scalable solution for project management. Deploy it effortlessly on Vercel and start managing your projects today.
features: Create, edit, and delete Kanban boards.
Manage board members with add/remove functionality.
Responsive design for mobile and desktop devices.
User authentication with JWT-based session management.
